name: Service Project 101
description:
Last February UP CSI held Service Project 101, led by our Vice President for Service, Aaron Tanael. Together we delved into the qualities of an excellent project manager, as well as the operational workflows and responsibilities of the teams that drive the success of UP CSI’s Service Projects.
Since 2013, UP CSI has been doing its part to give back to the community through upskilling students in tech and fostering the spirit of #innovation to tackle real-world problems with our clients.
